name: cg_nft_list
description:
NFT collections tracked by CoinGecko (nfts/list).
Returns {nfts: [{id, contract_address, name, asset_platform_id, symbol}, ...]} (one page of CoinGecko's list).
Inputs: none.
Collection ids can be looked up by name with cg_search.
Example: {}
